name: Autotweet
description: Memory-backed editorial suggestions, Typefully draft generation, style-guide bootstrapping, and draft queue management.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_AUTOTWEET_CONFIG
requiredConfig.description: Path to the local autotweet config markdown file.

requiredSecrets.name: TYPEFULLY_API_KEY
requiredSecrets.description: Typefully API key for creating drafts.

privateDataPolicy: Do not store Typefully credentials, unpublished draft contents, private KB paths, or account-specific social IDs in the plugin manifest.
